base_dir.description: Root directory where cached packages, indexes, and metadata are stored.

temp_dir.description: Directory for temporary files (e.g., incomplete downloads). Should be on fast I/O storage.

log_dir.description: Directory where access and error logs are written.

bind_address.description: IP address to bind the server to. Use '127.0.0.1' to restrict to local only.

port.description: TCP port the server listens on. Clients must point to this port (e.g., http://server:3142).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections. Increase for high-traffic environments.

max_age.description: Maximum age (in seconds) of cached metadata before it's refreshed from upstream. Default: 7 days.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for upstream response before giving up. Reduce for faster failure in unstable networks.

compression.description: Compression format for cached files. 'gzip' saves disk space; 'none' may improve speed on I/O-bound systems.

use_pipelining.description: Whether to enable HTTP/1.1 request pipelining for better upstream throughput. Disable if upstream has bugs.

use_gzip_encoding.description: Enable gzip content encoding for downloads. Reduces bandwidth but increases CPU usage.

support_deb822.description: Enable support for DEB822-style Sources files (apt ≥ 2.7). Required for newer Ubuntu/Debian clients.

normalize_path.description: Normalize request paths to avoid duplicate caching (e.g., /dists/ and /dists are treated identically).

upstream_proxies.description: List of upstream HTTP proxies to use (e.g., corporate proxies). Format: 'host:port' or 'host:port:user:pass'. Leave empty if none.

items.description: Proxy URL in the form 'host:port' or 'host:port:username:password'.

mirrors.description: List of repositories or mirrors to cache. Each entry maps an upstream URL to a local cache path.

local_path.description: Local cache subdirectory under BaseDir, e.g., 'ubuntu'. Must be unique per mirror.
